image_description: A close-up portrait of a common iguana's head and upper body against a black background. The iguana is facing right, showing its textured green and grey scales, prominent dorsal crest spines, large eye with golden iris, and the large circular subtympanic shield below the ear area. The dewlap is partially visible at the bottom of the frame.
